subject: Inspect Codex Goldfish native rc1 after EGM source pin repair
body: Read-only inspect local Codex logs and report after rc1, no model rerun or code edits.

argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,json,collections,re
root=pathlib.Path.home()/'.dore/egm-p2-review-131f3769711c'
proof=root/'.dev/egm/p2-4fa21ce51444'
print('ROOT',root.exists(),'PROOF',proof.exists())
report=root/'docs/design/P2-VOL00-EGM-GOLDFISH-REPORT.md'
print('REPORT',report.exists())
if report.exists():
 s=report.read_text(errors='replace')
 print('REPORT_SIZE',len(s),'REPORT_HEAD',s[:900].replace('\n',' | '),'REPORT_TAIL',s[-700:].replace('\n',' | '))
for name in ('codex-exitcode.txt','codex-final.md','codex-stderr.log','egm-source-authority.txt'):
 f=proof/name
 if f.exists():
  t=f.read_text(errors='replace')
  print('PROOF',name,len(t),t[-1800:].replace('\n',' | '))
ev=proof/'codex-events.jsonl'
if ev.exists():
 lines=ev.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
 print('EVENT_COUNT',len(lines))
 types=collections.Counter()
 for l in lines:
  try:
   o=json.loads(l);types[o.get('type','?')]+=1
  except:types['invalid-json']+=1
 print('EVENT_TYPES',dict(types))
 for l in lines[-16:]:
  try:
   o=json.loads(l)
   t=o.get('type','?')
   if t in ('item.completed','item.started','item.updated'):
    item=o.get('item',{})
    it=item.get('type','?') if isinstance(item,dict) else '?'
    out=(item.get('aggregated_output') or item.get('text') or item.get('message') or item.get('command') or '') if isinstance(item,dict) else ''
    print('EVENT',t,it,str(out)[-400:].replace('\n',' | '))
   else:print('EVENT',t,str(o)[-700:].replace('\n',' | '))
  except:print('EVENT INVALID')
PY
